headline: Mooring County Leads the Ownership Ledger
war_summary: The latest returns keep Mooring County at the head of the ownership ledger, with 55 strategic-base events in 24 hours and three in the latest two-hour watch. Its map remains divided—eight Colonial, four Warden and no neutral holdings—while casualties and enlistments are both accelerating. Linn Mercy has stirred since the previous edition, recording five events in two hours and 34 across the day; nine Colonial, one Warden and one neutral base now stand in a district where enlistments are also quickening. Weathered Expanse rose to 37 daily events, though its latest two-hour watch was quiet and activity has cooled; the map holds three Colonial, two Warden and four neutral positions. Callums Cape has slackened to 28 daily events, with one in the latest two hours, but its seven bases remain split five to two. Marban Hollow eased to 12 daily events while retaining four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral site. Elsewhere, Deadlands shows sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments despite no recorded base event, making it a watchful rear-sector entry. The coming day’s clearest ownership signals remain concentrated in Mooring, Linn and Weathered.
